reachableVia: ExtractionDebug.finalSelections.brand.brandDiagnostics.candidates — the complete production array, kept AND rejected, before any evaluation-side projection

capsExplicitlyNotApplied.MAX_BRAND_CANDIDATES: the eval-harness CaseReport cap at line 415 is bypassed entirely, not raised
capsExplicitlyNotApplied.MAX_TEXT_LEN: the 120-character truncate() applied to rawText and cleanedValue in the CaseReport projection is bypassed
capsExplicitlyNotApplied.keptOnlyFilter: not applied; rejected candidates are persisted

storageFormat.layout: one JSONL file per case, one JSON object per candidate decision, one line per record
storageFormat.why: Keeps the evidence reviewable and removes any reason for a retention cap.

stableCandidateId.derivedAs: sha256 of caseId + passId + assembly + lineIndexes + rawText, truncated to 16 hex
stableCandidateId.note: Derived by the acquisition for cross-referencing. It is an identifier, not a measurement.

sourceSpans.note: whole-line, line-window or multi-line merge; the span shape production recorded

producerCompanyIndicators.note: The producer-line determination is observable only as the recorded filterReason value `producer-line`. The underlying boolean signals are computed inside a module-local predicate and are not emitted.

positionInCompleteRankedList.derivedAs: index in the complete list ordered by the production ranking comparator, computed over ALL ranked candidates rather than a truncated head

everyIndividualFilterCheck.why: BLOCKER. The Brand filter is a short-circuit if-chain (field-selection.ts:1649-1917) that RETURNS on the first failing check. Production records exactly one filterReason per candidate: the first rule that fired. The results of the checks that were never reached do not exist.
everyIndividualFilterCheck.consequence: Acquisition cannot record every rule that would have rejected a candidate, only the one that did.
everyIndividualFilterCheck.wouldRequire: a production change to evaluate all predicates and emit a reason array — explicitly forbidden by this sprint

everyActiveRejectionReason.why: Same blocker. `filterReason` is a single BrandLineReason, not an array.
everyActiveRejectionReason.whatIsAvailable: the one reason recorded per candidate, and the union of reasons across the several distinct candidate objects a case may produce

filterLadderOrderNote: Recorded because it is the exact evaluation order and therefore determines which single reason is observable for any candidate. A candidate rejected at producer-line may or may not also violate too-many-words; that is unknowable from acquisition evidence.

countingProof.proofRule: the number of emitted records per case must equal brandDiagnostics.candidates.length read before any projection
